history.summary: New freehold 4BR (1205 sqft) at Ocho, a small Geylang (D14) boutique development not completing until 2033, at $2.18M / $1813 PSF. Freehold near Aljunied is appealing, but a 7-year build-out, no resale data, and a Geylang-fringe boutique profile make this speculative as an investment.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, ~700m to Aljunied MRT (EW9), and a Paya Lebar Central backdrop are real positives, but completion in 2033 means capital is tied up for years before any 5-7yr hold even starts, and there is zero URA appreciation/transaction data to verify the $1813 PSF. Small boutique Geylang blocks are illiquid and carry location stigma. The strong Elo reflects price/spec, not verified fundamentals.
red_flags: Completion 2033 — capital locked for ~7 years before the hold clock starts
No URA appreciation, txn count, or median PSF — value unverifiable
Small boutique Geylang-fringe development — limited liquidity and some stigma
catalysts: Freehold tenure near Aljunied MRT and Paya Lebar Central transformation
